files.description: Daily visitor counts at the north entrance (36 rows, rows not in date order, each day at most once, some days missing): day (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD, September-October 2025), visitors (whole number; equal counts are common), remark (short note; about 47% empty). The dates overlap only partly with footfall_south.csv.

Daily visitor counts at the south entrance (36 rows, rows not in date order, each day at most once, some days missing): day (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD, September-October 2025), visitors (whole number; equal counts are common), remark (short note; about 47% empty). The dates overlap only partly with footfall_north.csv.

task_text: Add up the visitors of both entrances for each day (an entrance with no count for a day adds 0). Going through the days in calendar order, work out for each day how much the total changed compared with the previous day listed. `result` should be a Series indexed by day in calendar order holding that change (empty for the first day).
intended_computation: Total visitors per day = north count + south count, with a missing count taken as 0, over the 47 days that appear in either file. Sort the days ascending; for each day the change is its total minus the total of the preceding day in that sorted list; the first day has no change (missing). Result: Series indexed by day, ascending.

acceptable_variants.notes: the first day's change is empty (missing value in any representation).

predicted_direction.reason: On 3.x concat(sort=False) keeps the days in file order, so diff() compares days that are not neighbours in the calendar; 2.x sorted the dates and gives the requested changes.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row R01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
